79249444.sourceDescription:
Welcome in the festive season with this 6ft 6 Inches Pre-Lit Aspen Artificial Christmas Tree. This premium and realistic artificial Christmas tree is easy to set up with the EZ Connect™ and Simple Shape™ technologies, as the tree springs into shape and lights up once tree poles are connected. Pre-strung with 1,500 colour-changing Radiant Micro LED lights with 5 effects and a dimmer option, they’re all controlled conveniently with a remote controller.
STUNNING PRE-LIT CHRISTMAS TREE – Beautiful 6.5ft (1.9m) Aspen artificial tree pre-lit with 1,500 radiant colour-changing Micro LED lights, creating a warm festive glow without the hassle of stringing lights.
ADVANCED LIGHTING FUNCTIONS – Includes a convenient remote control offering 5 dazzling light effects and 13 brightness levels, allowing you to easily customise your holiday ambience to suit any mood or celebration.
EZ CONNECT™ SETUP FOR QUICK ASSEMBLY – Innovative EZ Connect™ technology powers the entire tree as soon as the poles are connected, eliminating messy plugs and making setup fast, safe, and stress-free.
REALISTIC FOREST FRESH™ BRANCHES – Features 3,760 Forest Fresh™ Simple Shape™ branch tips with a premium PE/PVC blend (80% PE / 20% PVC) for an ultra-realistic look and full, natural coverage from top to base.
DURABLE & STABLE DESIGN – Comes with a heavy-duty metal stand and locking mechanism for reliable stability throughout the season, ensuring your tree remains perfectly upright and secure indoors.
Guarantee - 1 year

0791537537144.sourceDescription: Effortless Pop Up and Collapsible Design This 5ft artificial Christmas tree features a smart pull up construction that allows for rapid assembly and disassembly within seconds. Requiring absolutely no tools, its slim pencil tree profile makes it an ideal choice for small spaces, flats, cosy corners, apartments, and modern living rooms. Pre Decorated with Red Baubles and Holly Leaves Designed with a rich dark green tinsel base, this unique holiday tree is embellished with realistic green holly leaf cutouts and comes pre installed with 20 shiny small red balls. The ornaments are securely attached to save you time and effort from buying and hanging individual Christmas baubles. Complimentary 4.5M LED Star String Light Included Each collapsible Christmas tree comes complete with a bonus 4.5 metre battery operated fairy light string featuring 30 bright star shaped bulbs. The warm, inviting glow weaves seamlessly through the dense green foliage, creating a traditional, festive winter atmosphere in your hallway or office. Sturdy Stand and Reusable Construction Supported by a durable four legged base, this tall narrow tinsel Christmas tree remains upright, steady, and balanced throughout the festive season. Made from premium, flame retardant PVC materials, it offers a mess free alternative to real pine trees that you can reuse year after year. Versatile Christmas Indoor Decorations Perfect for decorating home entryways, bedroom corners, dining areas, covered porches, or school classrooms. The classic green and red color combination blends effortlessly with traditional holiday themes, making it a wonderful seasonal gift for family, friends, and college students.

This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The gold finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details

5037204495344.sourceDescription:
Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display. The blue finish and plastic construction give them a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Single item designed to add a defined decorative detail to your display.
Versatile accessory that helps create a focal point within your arrangement.
Simple design allows easy coordination with existing room accents and textures.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 1 piece
Hanger included

5058194838744.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Pink. Stated size: 8 cm. Quantity: 45 pack.
Lightweight design for easy handling and convenient storage.
Vibrant pink colour adds festive detail to your Christmas tree.
Includes a generous 45-pack for extensive decoration coverage.
Durable plastic construction ensures long-lasting seasonal use.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 45 Christmas baubles
Hanger included

It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Use one as a centrepiece, place a pair either side of a doorway, or combine different sizes to create a glowing forest effect in the garden or a large room. A show-stopping alternative to a traditional tree, it brings instant festive impact with none of the needles, and can be enjoyed year after year. Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Plan the display

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Welcome guests and brighten your home with this beautiful artificial wreath. Designed for year-round appeal or seasonal celebrations, it offers a lasting, low-maintenance alternative to fresh flowers. It provides an immediate decorative lift to any door, wall, or mantelpiece, setting a warm and inviting tone.

Crafted from high-quality, durable materials, this wreath is designed to resist fading and maintain its shape season after season. The foliage, berries, and floral elements are carefully arranged on a sturdy, natural-looking twig base, creating a full and realistic appearance. This robust construction ensures it can be stored and reused for multiple holidays. Unlike natural wreaths, it requires no watering or maintenance and will not shed needles or petals, making it a clean and practical choice.

This wreath is available in two versatile sizes. The 25cm option is perfect for smaller doors or interior walls, while the larger 34cm version makes a substantial statement on a front door or above a fireplace. Both sizes feature a approx 7cm depth, giving them a rich, three-dimensional profile that adds texture and visual interest to any flat surface.

Imagine the welcoming sight this wreath provides as you return home, or the festive atmosphere it creates during a family gathering. It’s an effortless way to mark the changing seasons, whether celebrating the fresh start of spring or the cosy warmth of the winter holidays. This single piece simplifies your seasonal changeover, allowing you to instantly refresh your home's ambiance.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Inflatable Christmas Presents
These inflatable Christmas presents add a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Create a classic festive centrepiece with the Pelle & Sol 5ft Artificial Christmas Tree. Featuring 450 lush branch tips with supplied thicknesses of 0.07mm and 0.1mm, the tree is designed to recreate the appearance of natural Christmas greenery while giving you plenty of space for your own baubles, ornaments and lights. A sturdy stand helps support the tree once assembled, while the reusable artificial design can be packed away after Christmas for future festive seasons. Also available in 4ft with 280 tips and 6ft with 550 tips.
450 realistic branch tips – Creates a fuller green appearance while providing plenty of individual branches for baubles, ornaments and festive lighting.
0.07mm/0.1mm branches – Supplied branch thickness specifications help create structured artificial foliage that can be arranged before decorating.

Indoor and outdoor decorating – Suitable for creating festive displays inside the home or in suitable outdoor seasonal decorating areas.

5056774916844.sourceDescription:
Ready to soak in the Christmas vibe? Our green spruce Christmas tree is ready to visit your lovely home. A natural lifelike appearance presents you with a full and fluffy feeling; Stunning warm lights highlight your Christmas Eve. Premium quality materials ensure this artificial tree durable and sturdy; Bendable branch tips are easy to lift and down for pre-setting; Versatile design allows the whole family to enjoy a fun time decorating at their will. This tree is easy to assemble with a foldable stand and three other sections of the tree body. PVC needles and metal frame gives you a very traditional feel both to the touch.
Durable Materials: Made from flame-retardant PVC, the branches and tips are durable and lifelike. The sturdy metal trunk and stand ensure long-time use year after year.
Convenient Design: The metal stand of this artificial Christmas tree can be folded, and the segmented trunks are detachable, making the tree easy to tuck away. You can effortlessly pack and store them in your house.
Hassle-free Maintenance: The water-resistant PVC leaves and powder-coated metal trunk make the maintenance of this Christmas tree easy and convenient. Simply use a damp cloth and mild cleaners to keep your tree looking fresh and festive.
Flexible Tips: The bendable tips on the Christmas tree allow you to shape the tree to your liking. Fluff out the tips for a full look or create a unique shape as you wish, customizing your Christmas tree to fit your style. It usually takes some time to fluff out and shape the tree.
Gothic Black Tree: This black Christmas tree is ideal for a dark, gothic decorating theme. Its black foliage creates an eerie, sophisticated look, pairing well with creepy and edgy decorations and creating a spooky, unconventional display style.
